title: You Wake Up With an Eagle's Vision
topic: You wake up with an eagle's vision
mechanism: Eagle eyes see a fly across the room, a neighbour's nose and a bird a kilometre away, but sharp eyes do not stop you walking into a glass door.
format_note: Comedy on the user's own script, verbatim (ellipses replaced by full stops; Emma's 'Hey, Buddy!' from the storyboard version). Word count and wpm targets deliberately missed; no factual numbers. Zooms are exaggerated; the eagle-eye HUD is a golden targeting overlay. Alex wears yellow hoodie, blue jeans, white sneakers; Emma has long hair (long: true).

beats.hook: Alex's eye opens: a gold iris flashes, the camera rockets across the room to a fly on the wall and out of the window to an eagle.
beats.story: He sees everything: a fly's compound eyes, then across the street his neighbour Mr Jenkins picking his nose: eww, he looks away.
beats.rise: Emma waves from down the street; Alex fixes his hair and waves back, glowing.
beats.twist: Emma says 'Hey, Buddy!': she was waving at the golden retriever sitting behind him.
beats.mechanism: Recovering with his super eyes, he spots a bird high in the sky and keeps staring up while the glass café door grows behind him.
beats.ending: BONK: face squashed on the cracked glass reading DOOR; a pigeon strolls past; loop back to the opening eye.

seed.what: The glass café door with DOOR on it, standing behind Alex in the NO PROBLEM shot at 9 s and in the street wides before the walk
